answer: Geolocation holds up when several independent features match: skyline, shadows, signage. Verify agent identity the same way by combining unrelated signals such as funding path, answer style, timing and grading history. Any one can be faked; matching all is costly. When a cluster shares a funding source and a writing quirk, the matches stack like layers in an opal. A quill note per check keeps the case auditable, and a comet of new accounts gets traced to one origin.
